question: 同环比增长多少
content:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN date_id = 20260919 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN date_id = 20260918 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END))
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date_id = 20260918 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS mom_growth_rate,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN date_id = 20260919 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN date_id = 20250919 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END))
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date_id = 20250919 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS yoy_growth_rate
FROM fact_order
WHERE date_id IN (20260919, 20260918, 20250919);

FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dr.province = '四川省'
  AND dd.month = 1;

question: 哪些品牌的销售额低于5000元？
content:
SELECT d.brand
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_product d ON f.product_id = d.product_id
GROUP BY d.brand
HAVING SUM(f.order_amount) < 5000;

question: Adidas这个品牌的销售额是多少？
content: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = '阿迪达斯';

question: 华南大区的销售额是多少？
content:
SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
WHERE dr.region_name = '华南';

question: 北京市1月的销售额是多少？
content: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS sales_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE r.province = '北京市' AND d.month = 1;

question: 1月每天的销售额分别是多少？
content:
SELECT d.day, SUM(o.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.date_id >= 20260101 AND d.date_id < 20260201
GROUP BY d.day
ORDER BY d.day;

question: 3月卖得最好的商品是什么？
content:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(o.order_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.month = 3
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 各个品牌卖出去的金额分别是多少？
content:
SELECT dp.brand, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id

question: Mate的销售额是多少？

question: Q1一共卖了多少件商品？
content:
SELECT SUM(f.order_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.quarter = 'Q1'
  AND d.date_id BETWEEN 20260101 AND 20260331;

question: 最近生意好不好
content:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260913 AND 20260919 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS recent_7d_gmv,
  SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260906 AND 20260912 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS previous_7d_gmv,
  SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260913 AND 20260919 THEN order_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS recent_7d_quantity,
  SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260906 AND 20260912 THEN order_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS previous_7d_quantity,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260913 AND 20260919 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260906 AND 20260912 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END)) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date_id BETWEEN 20260906 AND 20260912 THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END), 0),
    4
  ) AS gmv_change_rate
FROM fact_order
WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20260906 AND 20260919;
